_about: Addison Webster Moore (1866-1930), Chicago pragmatist, Dewey's colleague. Not A. W. Moore the Manx folklorist (shelf aw-moore), so only his full name forms are used. Raw IA OCR: The Functional versus the Representational Theories of Knowledge in Locke's Essay (Chicago: University of Chicago Contributions to Philosophy, 1902); Pragmatism and its Critics (University of Chicago Press, 1910). Held: Existence, Meaning, and Reality in Locke's Essay and in Present Epistemology, an offprint whose scan shows no printed year. His chapter in Creative Intelligence (1917) is already on the john-dewey shelf. US public domain. No uids minted.
